title: Two brothers bet their house on this game
caption: The brothers behind Cuphead quit their jobs and remortgaged their house to finish it. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #cuphead #studiomdhr

instagram.caption:
Chad and Jared Moldenhauer loved 1930s cartoons, so they set out to make a game that looked hand drawn frame by frame.

It took far longer than planned. They quit their jobs and remortgaged their house to keep Studio MDHR alive.

Cuphead launched in 2017, sold millions and became a Netflix show. The bet was real, and it worked.
